videos.why: The owner-approved sample's topic, and the fullest picture: a train or riders moving in every frame, a secret room (M42) and a 90-second ride as the payoff; QA called it the bar for the other two (moved above rank's 6.3).
strengths: Famous place named in frame 1, answer held back
Secret room as the turn, a time figure the viewer can feel as payoff
risks: Title opens with the same 'How deep does' as the recipe's sample; a lot of New York for a global channel

videos.why: A strong hook (London's deepest station has no escalators) and a ghost station as the turn; its stills are a little emptier than Grand Central's.
strengths: Hook with a surprise you can picture
A station that never opened as the turn
320 steps: a payoff anyone can feel
risks: North End is said in feet while the rest is in metres
Fewer moving things than Grand Central

videos.why: The most famous subject of the three and a clear 'what holds it up' story, but a foundation has no trains, so the picture is quieter, and the payoff (110,000 tonnes) is a big number rather than something you feel.
strengths: World-famous subject, recognisable needle in frame 1
Groundwater that eats concrete as a turn
risks: Quieter picture: needed a camera sway to pass the motion gate
